name: rect
purpose: A rectangle as a location, from four fractions of the image's frame.
when_to_use: When the region to mask is a known box: a caller's coordinates, a detector's bbox, a plain test shape.
when_not_to_use: When the region has a shape (use a polygon or a stroke) or must be found (use a finder).
output_guidance: A bbox location in the image's frame; `rasterize` makes it a mask. Not applicable when the box lies wholly outside the frame.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image whose frame the box is in.

outputs.name: location
outputs.purpose: The box as a bbox location.

params.name: bbox
params.purpose: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the frame; x0 < x1 and y0 < y1

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the frame; x0 < x1 and y0 < y1

location.description: The box as a bbox location.
